usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas: daily spot foreign exchange rates
usdRate.note: The Bahamian dollar is pegged at par: the Central Bank buys and sells US dollars at 1.0000.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas: Monthly Economic and Financial Developments, September 2026 (retail price index from the Bahamas National Statistical Institute)
inflation_cpi.note: Retail price index 127.3 in July 2026 against 122.8 in July 2025, up 3.7% year on year (latest month shown). The end-of-period index in the CBOB Quarterly Statistical Digest rose 2.3% in December 2025 on a year earlier.

inflation_projection.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 8.2: retail price index 2016-2025 average about 2.2% a year; Bahamian dollar fixed at par with the US dollar
inflation_projection.note: The one-to-one US-dollar peg anchors prices; the retail price index rose about 2.2% a year over 2016-2025 (2.8% since 2020) and 3.7% in the year to July 2026, so we plan with 2.5%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas Quarterly Statistical Digest (August 2026), table 4.1: Selected Interest Rates
policy_rate.note: Bank Rate (the rate at which banks borrow from the Central Bank) 4.00%, unchanged since 2016.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas Quarterly Statistical Digest (August 2026), table 4.3: Deposit Rates of the Banking System
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on savings deposits 0.25% in June 2026 (0.25-0.28% through 2026).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas Quarterly Statistical Digest (August 2026), table 4.3: Deposit Rates of the Banking System
fdr_3m_rate.note: Fixed deposits up to 3 months averaged 0.40% in June 2026 (0.25-0.34% earlier in 2026).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas Quarterly Statistical Digest (August 2026), table 4.3: Deposit Rates of the Banking System
fdr_1y_rate.note: Fixed deposits of 6-12 months averaged 0.36% in June 2026; deposits over 12 months 1.33%. The highest rate offered in September 2026 was 2.25%, on fixed balances over 12 months (CBOB monthly report).

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product rate is published in the Central Bank of The Bahamas deposit rate tables.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas: Monthly Economic and Financial Developments, September 2026
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Banks' weighted average deposit rate narrowed by 10 basis points to 0.62% in September 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas: Bahamas Savings Bond prospectus, November 2024
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Bahamas Savings Bond 4-year tenor fixed coupon 3.43% (6-year 3.99%, 2-year 3.01%, 1-year 2.81%), paid semi-annually, units of B$100, sold through the Central Bank. Latest prospectus found is from November 2024 (older than 2025).

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas: Treasury bill tender results, 13 and 14 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day bills average yield 3.44% (discount rate 3.41%); 182-day 3.66%; 364-day 3.85% (3.87% at the 28-29 October tender).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas (registrar): Bahamas Registered Stock reopening results, 14 and 15 October 2026
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year Bahamas Registered Stock due 15 October 2031: average competitive yield 4.75% (3-year 4.25%, 7-year 5.51%).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of The Bahamas (registrar): Bahamas Registered Stock reopening results, 14 and 15 October 2026
tbond_10y_rate.note: Closest tenor to 10 years: 11-year Bahamas Registered Stock due 14 July 2037, average competitive yield 5.20%.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: The Bahamas, individual taxes on personal income (last reviewed 21 July 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: There is no personal income tax in The Bahamas, so bank interest is untaxed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: The Bahamas, individual taxes on personal income (last reviewed 21 July 2026)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No personal income tax, so Bahamas Savings Bond coupons are untaxed.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Insurance Corporation of The Bahamas: FAQs
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Each eligible deposit at a member bank or credit union is insured up to B$50,000 per depositor, principal and interest included.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published average credit card rate found; the CBOB loan rate table gives consumer loans at 12.0% and overdrafts at 11.1% (June 2026) but no card rate.

equity_return_low.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 3.6: BISX All Share index 1,938 (end-2016) to 3,110 (end-2025)
equity_return_low.note: Low case near the 3.4-3.9% Treasury bill yields, for a weak decade in a small, illiquid market.

equity_return_base.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 3.6: BISX index up about 5.4% a year 2016-2025 before dividends; 364-day T-bill 3.87%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: index price gains of about 5% plus dividends, capped near 3 points above the untaxed 1-year bill rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 3.7: BISX and US equity annual returns
equity_return_high.note: High case if local or US-dollar global equities repeat their long-run record of about 9-10%.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Bahamian dollar fixed at par with the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold prices with no currency depreciation under the peg.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Bahamian dollar fixed at par with the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected depreciation under the peg.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Bahamian dollar fixed at par with the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: money left in bank deposits, which pay well under 1.5%.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: savings bonds and Treasury bills, untaxed.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched the Insurance Commission of The Bahamas material: no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio published.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in The Bahamas, but no regulator or other non-company source publishing premium rates by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found for The Bahamas.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source publishing private health insurance premiums by age found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 8.2: health sub-index 119.0 (2016) to 168.3 (2025)
goal_inflation_health.note: The health price index rose about 3.9% a year over 2016-2025, so we plan with 4%.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBOB QSD table 8.2: education sub-index 109.5 (2016) to 107.2 (2025)
goal_inflation_education.note: The education index was flat over 2016-2025, but school fees tend to track wages, so we plan with the 2.5% headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 75.0 for 2026 (men 71.4, women 78.6).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 17.2 (2025, World Bank), 27.9 (2040) and 42.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/bahamas/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: National Insurance Board of The Bahamas: long-term benefits (Retirement Benefit)
retirement_age_default.note: Full NIB Retirement Benefit from 65 with at least 500 weekly contributions; it can be taken from 60 at a reduced rate. No separate statutory private-sector retirement age found.

retirement_age_government.note: Searched for the public service retirement age under The Bahamas Pensions Act: no reachable official source found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings left in bank deposits.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the untaxed 1-year Treasury bill yield, using savings bonds and bills.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBOB: 5-year Bahamas Registered Stock 4.75%; 6-year savings bond 3.99%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of savings bonds and registered stock.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of bills/bonds (3.4-4.75%) and local equities
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix in a weak decade.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of bills/bonds (3.4-4.75%) and equities (7% base)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case for a roughly half-and-half mix of government securities and equities.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of registered stock (up to 5.5%) and equities (9.5% high case)
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with a strong equity decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: NIB pays a means-tested Old Age Non-Contributory Pension from 65, but its current monthly amount is not stated on the NIB assistance payments page.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: National Insurance Board of The Bahamas: assistance payments (Old Age Non-Contributory Pension)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Monthly pension for needy Bahamian residents aged 65 or older who do not meet the contribution conditions for the NIB Retirement Benefit and pass a test of resources; eligibility is verified twice a year.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity found; the Employment Act provides severance pay on redundancy or dismissal, but its official text could not be read to confirm the scale.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Insurance Board of The Bahamas: long-term benefits (Retirement Benefit and Retirement Grant)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory National Insurance: monthly Retirement Benefit, payable for life, from 65 (from 60 at a reduced rate) of 30-60% of average insurable wage with at least 500 weekly contributions; a one-off Retirement Grant at 65 with 150-499 contributions. No automatic indexation found; untaxed as there is no personal income tax.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product rate published.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Fixed-coupon government savings bond for individuals, sold in B$100 units through the Central Bank.

tbill_91d.localNameEn: Government of The Bahamas Treasury bill (91, 182 or 364 days)
tbill_91d.note: Sold at Central Bank tenders; non-competitive bids are accepted.

equity_fund.note: Investment funds are regulated by the Securities Commission of The Bahamas.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mainly sold as jewellery and coins.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Commission of The Bahamas: complaints

oldAgeAllowance.name: National Insurance Board: Old Age Non-Contributory Pension
